summary.text: Jim Kalberloh is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 126 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A cattle farmer and restaurant owner, he lives in Lowry City, Missouri.

paragraphs.text: Kalberloh was born in Appleton City, Missouri, and lives in Lowry City, Missouri.
His career experience includes working as a cattle farmer and owning and operating Landmark Restaurant.
For the 2025-2026 session, Kalberloh was assigned to the Budget Committee, the Consent and House Procedure Committee and the Corrections and Public Institutions Committee.
